title: Smooth and Exact Parameterization of Continuous-time Signal Temporal Logic Specifications for Trajectory Optimization
summary: This paper presents a smooth parameterization of continuous-time Signal Temporal Logic (CT-STL) specifications for nonconvex trajectory optimization that is sound and complete up to the accuracy of the underlying numerical integration scheme. CT-STL provides a natural framework for encoding rich temporal and logical task requirements, but existing trajectory-optimization formulations typically enforce such specifications only at discrete sampling nodes.
